title: Cute & Cozy - Minutes to Downtown/BNA
description:
Your private Nashville retreat awaits! This bright, inviting condo comfortably sleeps 8 guests and is perfectly located for exploring Music City. Just minutes from the airport (BNA), Downtown Nashville, and Opryland. Relax in the cozy living room after a day of sightseeing. Features a fully equipped kitchen, private porch, and free parking. The perfect home base for your group's Nashville adventure!

The space
Unwind in a bright, inviting space perfectly located for exploring everything Music City has to offer. After a day of sightseeing, relax on the large sectional sofa in the welcoming living room, where a beautiful decorative fireplace with a reclaimed wood surround adds a touch of cozy charm.

Our comfortable condo is designed to host your group with ease. The modern, all-white kitchen is fully equipped for you to prepare meals, and the private back porch offers a peaceful, wooded view for your morning coffee.

This home comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests. The bed setup is as follows:
* Bedroom 1: One Queen Bed with an en-suite Jack-and-Jill bathroom and a walk-in closet.
* Bedroom 2: One Queen Bed, a bunk bed (Twin over Full), and an en-suite Jack-and-Jill bathroom with a walk-in closet.

Need more space? We own two other units in the same subdivision. Please inquire about booking multiple condos for groups of up to 24!

Guest access
Guests will have private and exclusive access to the entire condo during their stay. Make yourself at home in all rooms, common areas, and relax on the private back porch.

Other things to note
* Noise Potential: The condo is located near railroad tracks and the airport, so you may experience some related noise during your stay.
* Shared Walls: This is a condo complex, and our unit shares one wall with an adjoining condo. You may occasionally hear creaks from the floor or water running through pipes.
* Decorative Fireplace: The fireplace is for ambiance only. Please do not burn anything in it.
* Starter Supplies: We provide a starter kit of supplies (toilet paper, paper towels, etc.) to begin your stay. Guests are responsible for any additional items needed.
* Liability: All listed amenities are to be used at the guest’s own risk. The homeowner is not liable for any risk, danger, injury, or damages.
